entries.femaleVariant: V, right? Hodan Warsame here. I work in Charter Hill, only with the best.
entries.maleVariant: V, right? Hodan Warsame here. I work in Charter Hill, only with the best.

entries.femaleVariant: Heard about you. You get in and you get out. Some of my work is quiet, some isn't. Most of my clients have a problem with a corp.
entries.maleVariant: Heard about you. You get in and you get out. Some of my work is quiet, some isn't. Most of my clients have a problem with a corp.

entries.femaleVariant: I'll send you my number and the address. If you're looking for work in Charter Hill, call me.
entries.maleVariant: I'll send you my number and the address. If you're looking for work in Charter Hill, call me.

entries.femaleVariant: What's your story?
entries.maleVariant: What's your story?

entries.femaleVariant: What's new around here?
entries.maleVariant: What's new around here?

entries.femaleVariant: Any work?
entries.maleVariant: Any work?

entries.femaleVariant: How's business?
entries.maleVariant: How's business?

entries.femaleVariant: Nice place.
entries.maleVariant: Nice place.

entries.femaleVariant: Later.
entries.maleVariant: Later.

entries.femaleVariant: Mogadishu. Good family, law school. Then Orbital Air hired me as a lawyer at the spaceport.
entries.maleVariant: Mogadishu. Good family, law school. Then Orbital Air hired me as a lawyer at the spaceport.

entries.femaleVariant: So I read the contracts. People signed for years on a station and never paid off the debt. They were written so nobody could.
entries.maleVariant: So I read the contracts. People signed for years on a station and never paid off the debt. They were written so nobody could.

entries.femaleVariant: I started helping the smugglers who got people out. Inside a year I was running things.
entries.maleVariant: I started helping the smugglers who got people out. Inside a year I was running things.

entries.femaleVariant: Orbital Air found out, ambushed us. Most of my crew and passengers didn't make it out. I escaped to Night City.
entries.maleVariant: Orbital Air found out, ambushed us. Most of my crew and passengers didn't make it out. I escaped to Night City.

entries.femaleVariant: Now I find mercs. Some of my clients are suits fighting other suits. The rest have a problem with a corp. So do I.
entries.maleVariant: Now I find mercs. Some of my clients are suits fighting other suits. The rest have a problem with a corp. So do I.

entries.femaleVariant: There's a divorce going on upstairs.
entries.maleVariant: There's a divorce going on upstairs.

entries.femaleVariant: He's a politician. She got the penthouse and his depository receipts.
entries.maleVariant: He's a politician. She got the penthouse and his depository receipts.

entries.femaleVariant: He's paying somebody in Japantown to get them back. It's got nothing to do with you.
entries.maleVariant: He's paying somebody in Japantown to get them back. It's got nothing to do with you.

entries.femaleVariant: All quiet. Somebody went upstairs and came back down with the politician's depository receipts.
entries.maleVariant: All quiet. Somebody went upstairs and came back down with the politician's depository receipts.

entries.femaleVariant: He got his receipts back. Japantown got paid. Haven't seen her since.
entries.maleVariant: He got his receipts back. Japantown got paid. Haven't seen her since.

entries.femaleVariant: I kept a copy. Never know when it might come in handy.
entries.maleVariant: I kept a copy. Never know when it might come in handy.

entries.femaleVariant: When I've got something for you, I'll be in touch.
entries.maleVariant: When I've got something for you, I'll be in touch.

entries.femaleVariant: No catch. I don't take Orbital Air money. I don't hand people over to a corp.
entries.maleVariant: No catch. I don't take Orbital Air money. I don't hand people over to a corp.

entries.femaleVariant: Anything else, we can talk about.
entries.maleVariant: Anything else, we can talk about.

entries.femaleVariant: Can't complain. Somebody's always paying to steal from a corp.
entries.maleVariant: Can't complain. Somebody's always paying to steal from a corp.

entries.femaleVariant: Data, usually. Sometimes a person.
entries.maleVariant: Data, usually. Sometimes a person.

entries.femaleVariant: Getting a person out pays more. Taking a suit out pays the most.
entries.maleVariant: Getting a person out pays more. Taking a suit out pays the most.

entries.femaleVariant: The suits upstairs walk past me every day.
entries.maleVariant: The suits upstairs walk past me every day.

entries.femaleVariant: Nobody's ever asked a single question.
entries.maleVariant: Nobody's ever asked a single question.

entries.femaleVariant: Take care, V.
entries.maleVariant: Take care, V.
